historicalIncident.trigger: Effective application behavior composition changed because the Unified shell behavior was removed. This legitimately changed the qualification key; no other qualification-key component changed.
historicalIncident.phaseWarning: Several runtime-freeze entries are nested; do not sum all phase durations as independent work.
historicalIncident.remainingWorkerPreparation: Approximately8 seconds of worker bundle preparation/session mounting lacks separate Foundation activation, create_session and history-injection durations.
historicalIncident.displayInterpretation: Preparing community modules (activating) was the currently reported phase, not evidence that all approximately40 seconds were spent in that phase.
historicalIncident.repeatEvidence: The later read-only audit found the exact qualified index/environment and matching current configuration key. It did not time a second identical production worker start. A repeated40-second setup under unchanged inputs is not established.
historicalIncident.historicalSourceLimit: These retained receipts bind timing and configuration-key facts, plus recorded runtime packages; they do not contain a historical application Git commit. The current source review above is separate.

currentSourceFindings: RuntimeManager with no explicit command runs profile ensure before spawning a worker; an explicit worker command used by concurrency controls bypasses this qualification path.

runtime_profiles.ensure uses the parent generation, effective configuration and local source content to select a reusable qualified profile. Existing successful validated index hits return before snapshot, dependency preparation or freeze.
The community activating label is emitted by Foundation prepare inside host/session.py, after profile qualification and before complete session mounting.

Profile attempt receipts already separate preflight, lock wait, source snapshot, runtime preparation, installer policy, dependency preparation, freeze, compatibility and verification. Worker activation/mount/history timing still needs finer observation to attribute the remaining interval.

alreadyExecutedControls.boundary: Real ensure control/cache/receipt logic with synthetic preparation/process seams. These prove reuse/invalidation semantics, not actual full Work installation speed or end-user first-send latency.

reasons: Seeds dependencies using uv lock and uv sync, and references moving Git main sources.
Its calls time profile ensure, not the worker activation/mount or first-message acknowledgement phases.
Its synthetic provider configuration and cached dependencies differ from the historical user composition.
existingBenchmarkAssessment.historicalWorkBenchmark: Earlier October9 no-inference Work benchmark reported approximately11.50-second qualification and1-millisecond cache hits on its own older source/cache. It is not a measured40-second to11-second fix or a current full-cold baseline.

boundedOptionalFollowup.purpose: Measure already-qualified local profile reuse and isolate worker activation, without external inference or dependency installation.
boundedOptionalFollowup.setup: New owned DTU state and synthetic workspace; exact reviewed immutable Work source/dependency snapshot and parent receipt copied privately. No user credentials/history/schedules; local provider refuses all model calls. Keep normal RuntimeManager command unset.
boundedOptionalFollowup.networkPolicy: No external network or installer process. A missing local source/package is a failed prerequisite, never an implicit download or behavior removal.
cases: Same exact parent/config: one worker-cold start to runtime.ready, then Stop only its owned worker and repeat.
One second synthetic chat with unchanged composition: require same qualified profile and no additional qualification attempt.
assertions: Record ensure begin/end, selected immutable generation, spawn, Foundation prepare phase, session ready and exact cleanup.
Assert no provider complete call, prompt submission, external tool action, qualification attempt rewrite, source mutation or worker leak.
boundedOptionalFollowup.limits: This deliberately measures cache-warm/profile-warm worker starts. Fully cold dependency installation and changed full Work composition remain unmeasured; do not infer their timing from this control.

outstandingStatement: The historical delay was mostly a justified one-time runtime requalification after a behavior change. Current full-composition cold preparation latency and the remaining activation/mount interval have not been measured against a target. This is separate from warm-submit scale latency and is not established as a repeated warm regression.
